newsitem.title: USA: Holmes, EDS terminate outsourcing pact.
newsitem.headline: Holmes, EDS terminate outsourcing pact.

text.p: Holmes Protection Group Inc said on Wednesday it reached an agreement in principle with Electronic Data Systems Corp and its subsidiary, PremiTech Corp, to terminate their outsourcing agreement, effective March 31.
Holmes will record a one time pre-tax, non-recurring charge of about $1.5 million in the first quarter of 1997 as a result of this action.
The Outsourcing Agreement, which was effective April 1, 1995 and had an initial term of ten years, provided for PremiTech to manage various corporate support functions for Holmes in the Northeast.
Changes in Holmes' growth strategy in early 1996, and the sale by EDS of its alarm monitoring business in late 1995, led both parties to re-evaluate the Outsourcing Agreement, Holmes said.

Holmes Protection Group, Inc. provides security alarm monitoring services, and designs, sells, installs, and services electronic security systems for commercial and mid-to-high end residential customers.
